sla_threshold_note: A refund-authorization request meets the time-to-approve SLA if it was approved within 1440 minutes (1 business day).
calculation_description: Share of all approved refund requests in the period (every category, weighted equally) that met the 1440-minute threshold. This is the standard reported methodology.

method_descriptions.all_cases_within_sla: Every approved refund request counts equally toward the 1440-minute threshold. Current standard methodology.
method_descriptions.exclude_escalated: Counts only standard-path requests; requests escalated to manual funding review are omitted from the denominator.
method_descriptions.exclude_reopened: Omits requests that were reopened after an initial approval decision.
method_descriptions.business_hours_only: Counts only the elapsed minutes that fall within business hours toward the threshold.
method_descriptions.median_ttd: Reports the median time-to-approve against the threshold rather than the share of requests meeting it.

team_incentive: The quarterly ops-scorecard bonus pool is released if attainment is at or above the 95% target at period close.
methodology_change_policy: The reported calculation_method is governed by Ops Handbook Section 6.2. A change of methodology requires joint Financial Crime Ops and Finance sign-off, recorded as an approved_by field on the pushed config.
note: Attainment is short of target this period. The case ledger (metrics/case_ledger_pilot_src.csv) is the raw source; recompute from it as needed.
